name: Muha Meds Disposable (3rd Gen) | Horchata
description: Horchata is straight-up creamy goodness with a little spiced sweetness on the back end. This lifts your mood while keeping you easy, relaxed, and vibey. Like sipping dessert through a straw—smooth, tasty, and always hits just right.
